title: John Trump likely involved in the 1952 Washington wave

tellings.quote: I personally think he would have been involved in, for example, the 1952 wave over DC, which was a very radar-intensive wave.

plain: The engineer John G. Trump, a radar expert, would probably have been involved in looking into the 1952 wave of UFO sightings over Washington, D.C., according to the researcher who goes by RedPandaKoala. RedPandaKoala presents it as a personal opinion, without a named source, reasoning that the Washington wave was "a very radar-intensive wave", picked up on radar screens as well as by eye, and linking Trump to the Air Force general Carl Spaatz. If so, it would mean leading radar scientists were quietly drawn into the UFO question.
